chars.ABDEL: ABDEL: a young Moroccan man wearing a navy blue zip-up work jacket with orange reflective stripes on the sleeves, grey cargo trousers
chars.ACHRAF: ACHRAF: a tall slim young Moroccan man wearing a light beige short-sleeve shirt tucked into dark brown chinos, a thin black leather crossbody bag
chars.HASSAN: HASSAN: an older Moroccan farmer wearing a mustard-yellow long-sleeve work shirt under faded blue overalls, a red-and-white checked cloth wrapped around his head

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At dawn in a narrow Moroccan town street, ABDEL loads flat trays of young green seedlings into the boot of a dusty white hatchback while ACHRAF glances over his shoulder at the empty street; cold blue morning light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a moving dusty hatchback on a straight rural road between dry fields, ACHRAF grips the steering wheel with a tight grin while ABDEL steadies a tray of sickly yellow-spotted plants on his knees; tense excitement.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A dusty white hatchback stopped at the dirt edge of a huge irrigated Moroccan farm with long rows of greenhouses stretching to the horizon; ABDEL leans out of the passenger window scanning the field with a calculating stare; harsh midday sun.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Crouched low between two rows of tomato plants inside a big farm, ABDEL presses a diseased spotted seedling into the wet soil while ACHRAF stands a few metres away pretending to inspect leaves and watching the path; guilty and alert.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a sunlit farm courtyard of packed earth, ACHRAF shakes hands and laughs with HASSAN, holding his attention, while behind them ABDEL slips into a plastic greenhouse carrying a cardboard box.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At dusk on an empty dirt road beside a wire fence, ABDEL flings a handful of infected yellow leaves over the fence into the neighbouring field while ACHRAF stands by the open car door watching both ends of the road; orange sunset light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A wide view over a vast Moroccan tomato field where spreading patches of plants have turned yellow and wilted among healthy green rows; ACHRAF stands small on a dirt track at the edge looking out over the field; late afternoon haze.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In a dim narrow storeroom on the edge of Casablanca, ABDEL pours a cloudy liquid from a plastic jug into plain bottles while ACHRAF stacks the filled bottles in rows on metal shelves; single bare bulb, quiet satisfaction.
